reaction_context: carboxylative cyclization of propargyl alcohol with CO2
central_event: O-H cleavage at the propargyl alcohol

pathway_endpoint_definitions.assisted: an alcohol/metavanadate reactant complex progressing to an O-H-cleavage saddle point and its deprotonated alkoxy-metavanadate product complex
pathway_endpoint_definitions.alternative: a carbon-dioxide/metavanadate/alcohol complex progressing to an O-H-cleavage saddle point before the alkoxy product

allowed_model_boundary: isolated molecular clusters with an explicitly stated charge, multiplicity, solvation treatment and conformer protocol; no assumption of a periodic surface is required
